verdict.rationale: Docs reference Fluid compute for running 'server-side code on demand' (vercel-docs-19) and 'production workloads in isolated containers' (vercel-docs-12), implying full Node.js runtime support beyond a restricted Edge subset, but no evidence explicitly confirms unmodified Node.js APIs or full npm package compatibility in edge/serverless functions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation contrasting Node.js runtime vs restricted Edge Runtime, npm package compatibility guarantees, and independent verification of unmodified Node.js execution.
